import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
report = Path('products/services/catalogue-qa-agency-report/editor-report-en-fr.md')
fixture = report.with_name('untouched-images.csv')
receipt = Path('products/reviews/catalogue-editor-handoff/execution.json')
evidence = json.loads(receipt.read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256(report.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == evidence['report_sha256']
assert hashlib.sha256(fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == evidence['input_sha256']
negative = evidence['observations']['untouched-images.csv']
positive = evidence['observations']['editor-images.csv']
assert negative['exit_code'] == 2 and 'style SH-100: same image URL used twice' in negative['stderr']
assert positive['exit_code'] == 0
_, _, verification = positive['stdout'].partition('\n')
checks = json.loads(verification)['checks']
assert len(checks) == 12 and all(value is True for value in checks.values())
print(report.read_text())
print(json.dumps({'verified_checks': list(checks), 'commands': [negative['argv'], positive['argv']], 'manual_work': evidence['manual_work'], 'matched_file_lines': evidence['matched_file_lines']}, ensure_ascii=False))
